consumedSemantics: a final prior-evening session is consumed only by next-day My Day; previously consumed sources must not be rebound silently
eveningAdjustment: Final evening D-1 contributes to My Day D, never My Day D-1
idempotency: orchestration identity excludes consumed/fresh role and session revision so generation-success/consume-failure retry converges
forbidden: raw answers in My Day command
direct checkin DB reads from My Day
targetDateRule: My Day D uses MORNING on D and EVENING on D-1 in the user's canonical timezone
